title: Two near-simultaneous weigh-in submits from different components both write, producing duplicate same-day body_weight_entries rows
steps: Open WeighInPrompt's 'Log weight' field on one tab (weight=182) and Progress > Weight tab's field on a second tab/session (weight=181, notes tagged). Fire both submit clicks with no await between them.
expected: Only one same-day body_weight_entries row exists (an upsert-by-date, per the code's own client-side select-then-branch intent), or the second write is rejected/merged.
actual: 2 rows created for today: {weight:181, notes:"OVN-body-r1-01"} and {weight:182, notes:null}. useLogWeight's select-then-create/update has no unique constraint or transactional guard, so two concurrent callers both read zero existing rows and both insert.
evidence: script console output; rowsForToday=2 before cleanup
suspectFile: src/hooks/useWeighIn.js (useLogWeight — client-side select-then-create/update, no DB unique constraint on created_by+recorded_date)

title: Weight tab (Progress) has no bounds check — an implausible value (1810 lbs) saves silently
steps: Open Progress > Weight tab, backdate 3 days, enter weight=1810, tap Log.
expected: A sanity bound (WeighInPrompt already has one: lbs 50-700 / kg 25-320) rejects or warns on an implausible value.
actual: Row saved with weight=1810, no warning or confirm shown, success toast displayed as if normal.
evidence: script console output: saved=true sawSuccessToast=true sawConfirmOrWarning=false
suspectFile: src/pages/Progress.jsx (Weight tab input has no min/max, unlike WeighInPrompt.jsx's existing bounds guard)

title: Measurements tab inserts a new row per save instead of upserting by date, and 'Latest' isn't deterministic
steps: Open Measurements tab, enter Chest=100 tagged '-am', save. Immediately enter Chest=101 tagged '-pm' for the same date, save again.
expected: Either the second save updates the same-date entry, or the 'Latest' card deterministically reflects the most recently saved value.
actual: 2 rows exist for the same date (chest 100 and 101). The 'Latest' card did not reliably show the most recent (101/pm) value — history query orders by date only, no created_at tiebreak.
suspectFile: src/pages/Progress.jsx:209-222 (insert, no upsert), :202 (order by date only, no secondary sort)

title: Rapid double-tap delete on a water log entry
steps: Log a water entry (+100ml). Rapid-double-tap its Delete (X) button within ~150ms.
expected: One delete happens; second tap is a harmless no-op. No crash.
actual: ok — exactly 1 delete, remaining=0, zero pageerrors/click errors. No confirm dialog and no isPending guard exist on this button (confirmed by code inspection), but the double-tap itself did not produce a crash or duplicate-delete error here. See wishes.json for the no-confirm gap as a UX item.

title: Rapid double-tap delete on a supplement log entry
steps: Log a supplement dose. Rapid-double-tap its Delete button within ~150ms.
expected: One delete happens; second tap is a harmless no-op. No crash.
actual: ok — exactly 1 delete, remaining=0, zero problems. Same no-confirm/no-isPending gap as water (see wishes.json) but no functional failure.

title: Typing dose '0' when logging a supplement silently falls back to the default dose instead of logging 0
steps: Type '0' into the dose field for a supplement type with default_dose=5. Tap Log.
expected: The logged dose is 0 (explicitly typed) or the UI explains why 0 is rejected.
actual: Logged row has dose=5 (the default), not the typed 0. `dose: parseFloat(dose) || type.default_dose` treats parseFloat('0')===0 as falsy and silently substitutes the default.
evidence: script console output: rows=[5] loggedZero=false loggedDefault=true

title: Backfilling a past-dated weigh-in does not overwrite profile.current_weight
steps: Change Weight tab date to 5 days ago, enter a distinct weight, tap Log.
expected: profile.current_weight unchanged — only a same-day ("today") weigh-in should update it.
actual: ok — backfilled row saved (weight=171) and profile.current_weight stayed at its pre-test value (181) both before and after. The `dateStr === getTodayString()` guard in useWeighIn.js works correctly.
evidence: script console output: backfilledWeight=171 profileBefore=181 profileAfter=181

title: MorningCheckin (readiness/soreness/weigh-in) is completely unreachable when a workout is in-progress and today has no engine prescription — no alternate route exists
steps: With any workout_sessions row in status=in_progress and no prescription for today, open /today and look for the check-in form.
expected: The daily check-in (Energy/Mood/Soreness/weigh-in) is reachable somehow, even if a workout is mid-flight.
actual: Today.jsx:500 (`!(activeSession && !prescription)`) suppresses PrescribedSessionCard entirely in this state, and PrescribedSessionCard is the ONLY place MorningCheckin is imported/rendered anywhere in the app (confirmed by grep across src/). The intended r1-08 test (verify readiness/soreness commit even when the weight write is forced to fail) could not be run through the real UI because the form never renders at all — this is a more fundamental gap than the one the case set out to probe. Two in-progress workout_sessions rows currently exist on the shared test account (one tagged OVN-r1-03 Lift, a leftover from an earlier round; one untagged, real-looking data) — neither was touched, per ground rules, since deleting either would be altering state not created by this test.
evidence: script console output (controls() dump shows no Check In button reachable); Today.jsx:409-424,493-522

title: Rapid soreness-pill cycling — blocked by the same root cause as body-r1-08
steps: Same precondition as body-r1-08 (in-progress session + no prescription today) makes the soreness pills unreachable, since they live inside the same suppressed MorningCheckin/PrescribedSessionCard.
actual: Could not be exercised — see body-r1-08 for the full writeup. No DB writes were attempted for this case; nothing needed cleanup.

title: Reload mid guided-session photo queue (before tapping Analyze)
steps: Open /physique, tap Guided session, select 3 photos at once, on the review sheet for shot 1 of 3 reload the page before tapping Analyze.
expected: No physique_entries rows and no storage objects exist from the reload — queue state is client-only until Analyze is confirmed.
actual: ok — 0 entries, 0 new storage objects after reload. Confirms the code comment: nothing uploads until confirmUpload (Analyze) runs. (Unrelated: 50 pre-existing HTTP 400s were observed on page load from signed-URL requests for the account's existing physique photo thumbnails — not investigated further, real photo content is out of scope to inspect, but worth a look: every existing physique_entries thumbnail on this account is failing to generate a signed URL.)

title: analyze-physique edge function call fails CORS preflight — physique photo analysis is completely broken, and the failed upload orphans a storage object
steps: Open /physique, select a pose, upload a photo, tap Analyze.
expected: Photo is analyzed and a physique_entries row is created with the bodyfat estimate. (This case's actual target — whether a second same-day photo silently shifts the session-averaged BF% — requires this to work at all.)
actual: Analyze fails every time (2/2 consecutive attempts): pageerror "...functions/v1/analyze-physique due to access control checks.", console "Request header field apikey is not allowed by Access-Control-Allow-Headers." The storage upload (which runs BEFORE the analyze call in confirmUpload) still succeeds each time, leaving an orphaned object in the 'physique' bucket with no corresponding DB row and nothing shown in the UI. This blocked testing the session-averaging question entirely. Orphaned storage objects from both attempts were manually cleaned up.
evidence: script console output, 2 runs both failing identically
suspectFile: src/pages/PhysiqueTracker.jsx:39-58 (invokeAnalyzePhysique), :213-232 (confirmUpload — storage upload has no compensating cleanup on analyze failure); likely root cause is a CORS header allowlist gap on the analyze-physique Supabase Edge Function itself, not client code.

title: No in-app way to delete a physique entry (confirmed at runtime)
steps: Open /physique, tap the edit (pencil/"Fix pose") icon on any entry, inspect the dialog; also inspect the entry card and full page for any delete affordance.
expected: Either a delete path exists, or the gap is confirmed and logged.
actual: Edit dialog offers pose selection only, no delete option. No delete/remove/trash affordance found anywhere on the page. Matches static analysis: updatePoseMutation is the only entry mutation in PhysiqueTracker.jsx. Verified read-only (dialog closed via Cancel, no changes submitted).

title: Water goal personalization — happy-path verification
steps: Read profile.current_weight (184 lbs) and cross-check the Water card's "{total} / {goal} ml" label against waterGoalMl().

The DEFAULT_WATER_GOAL_ML=3000 fallback path (current_weight unset) was NOT exercised — doing so would require nulling the shared account's current_weight, which this case's own spec forbids.
